title: marquee-overflow — one line of type wider than the band, clipped at both edges
idea: One line set far larger than the band and clipped at both edges, so the visitor reads a fragment and infers the whole word. The overflow is deliberate and the rest of the band stays calm.
why_new: every recipe fits its type inside the measure; the fit-text device shrinks type to fit. This one does the opposite on purpose.
built_from: one heading with a reviewed overflow class and root overflow: hidden; imageless.
risk: a long site name clips to two illegible syllables. Needs a minimum-legible-fragment rule and a word-count gate before assignment.
